summary: The claimed estimates hold with the stated constants. The geometric-series identities, uniform moment bounds, symmetric integer displacement construction, finite cutoff inequalities, and four powers of the original normalizer are valid. The height and displacement counts remain valid at all positive auxiliary rates, including rates above one. The elementary regimes and the dimension threshold cover every allowed parameter triple. The predecessor's unconditional cubic estimate applies to the original complete lattice support and its globally log-concave extension with exactly the stated depth normalization and arithmetic dimension N=n+1.
